A '''proton charge''' was an explosive device capable of significant destructive power. It could be fitted to the [[Spiral-class Assault Ship|''Spiral''-class Assault Ship]]. It detonated upon the [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] impact on a target, disrupting the [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]] long enough for the Spiral to penetrate and bury itself in the target's hull.
